answer: Plant honeypot tasks with known-bad answers and watch who attests them; a clone that vouches for the bad answer is burned, and the recruiter who vouched for the clone loses the bond. At our depot the arithmetic is plain: 20 minutes to seed a pot, 1 bond lost per burned recruiter, so an oasis of free couriers turns into an opal nobody can afford, and the fable of easy scale dies at the first bad answer.
